cells.gaps: No share of offices registering has been found: 'all offices' (MAR-013, 2024-10-29) is the ministry's word with no count beside it, and the 59 of 97 (MAR-004, 2026-01-30) is over a programme's participating municipalities for a system whose function the report does not state. The April 2025 register project (MAR-022) gives 1,821 offices for its unified information system, a project figure from another source and not a count of offices registering. Later facts disagree with the 2024 account: in October 2025 communes were short of the paper registers called essential for registering births (MAR-009) and access to the national platform was still to be opened (MAR-010). The plan (MAR-016) carries no period. Finance is both: over 194 million dirhams allocated to the Interior Ministry's register digitisation and information-system project (MAR-023, April 2025, from the press), beside the World Bank loan behind the municipal back-office system (MAR-008). The identifier at birth is held only as what Law 36-21 provides.
cells.note: SGEC enters births and deaths at the civil-status office and is past pilot, but its reach is a share equipped, which places at stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of offices shown registering on a share or a count over the country's own total, and none is held; the domestic budget of April 2025 changes the governance qualifier only.
